capabilities: Embed external local files with wiki and Markdown syntax
Render external HTTP(S) pages in sandboxed iframes
Open vault-external wiki links with the system default app
Read large PDFs page-by-page with lazy rendering, zoom, and navigation
Size embeds via alt text or URL fragment parameters
extras: Desktop-only (uses Node.js and Electron APIs). README warns to use external paths only in trusted notes and notes that some websites block iframe embedding via their own security policy.
problem: Obsidian only embeds and links files inside the vault, so notes referencing external paths or websites cannot render them.
summary: Embeds vault-external files (PDFs, images, audio, video) and external web pages in notes using standard Obsidian wiki and Markdown embed syntax.
